```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Make the project root the working directory, so paths like "data/..." work
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5)
set.seed(123)   # reproducibility
```

# 1. Load packages

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(skimr)
library(naniar)
library(corrplot)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(e1071)
library(pROC)
```

# 2. Import data

```{r import}
raw <- read_excel("data/dataset-uci.xlsx")
dim(raw)
```

# 3. Data cleaning

## 3.1 Standardise names and convert variable types

```{r clean-and-types}
df <- raw |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    # Target: per UCI documentation 0 = gallstones present, 1 = absent
    gallstone_status = factor(gallstone_status, levels = c(0, 1),
                              labels = c("Gallstone", "No_gallstone")),
    gender = factor(gender, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    across(c(coronary_artery_disease_cad, hypothyroidism,
             hyperlipidemia, diabetes_mellitus_dm),
           ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")))
  )

glimpse(df)
table(df$gallstone_status)
```
## 3.2 Quality checks

```{r quality}
# Total missing values in the whole dataset (expected: 0)
sum(is.na(df))

# Duplicate rows (expected: 0)
sum(duplicated(df))

# Summary of every variable: check the min and max of each one
summary(df)
```

## 3.3 Save the cleaned dataset

```{r save-clean}
write_csv(df, "data/gallstone_clean.csv")
```

## 3.3 Age and other range checks

```{r boxplots, fig.width=11, fig.height=9}
df |>
  select(where(is.numeric)) |>
  pivot_longer(everything()) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = "", y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue") +
  facet_wrap(~ name, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5,
             labeller = label_wrap_gen(22)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Distribution of numeric variables") +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
```

## 3.4 Inspect suspicious values

```{r suspicious}
df |>
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) |>
  filter(obesity_percent > 150 |
         high_density_lipoprotein_hdl > 150 |
         muscle_mass_mm < 20 |
         total_body_water_tbw < 20 |
         glomerular_filtration_rate_gfr < 20 |
         low_density_lipoprotein_ldl < 30) |>
  select(row_id, age, gender, gallstone_status, weight,
         body_mass_index_bmi, obesity_percent, muscle_mass_mm,
         total_body_water_tbw, high_density_lipoprotein_hdl,
         low_density_lipoprotein_ldl, creatinine,
         glomerular_filtration_rate_gfr)
```

# 4. Exploratory data analysis

```{r eda-setup}
# One colour pair used in every figure (colour-blind friendly)
cols <- c(Gallstone = "#D55E00", No_gallstone = "#0072B2")
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## 4.1 Class balance

```{r eda-class}
p1 <- df |>
  count(gallstone_status) |>
  ggplot(aes(gallstone_status, n, fill = gallstone_status)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  labs(title = "Number of patients by gallstone status",
       x = NULL, y = "Number of patients") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
p1
ggsave("figures/01_class_balance.png", p1, width = 5, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```
## 4.2 Demographics and hepatic fat

```{r eda-demo}
# Age distribution
p2 <- ggplot(df, aes(age, fill = gallstone_status)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, colour = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ gallstone_status) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  labs(title = "Age distribution by gallstone status",
       x = "Age (years)", y = "Patients") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
p2
ggsave("figures/02_age_distribution.png", p2, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 300)

# Proportion with gallstones in each gender
p3 <- ggplot(df, aes(gender, fill = gallstone_status)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  labs(title = "Gallstone status by gender", x = NULL,
       y = "Proportion of patients", fill = "Status")
p3
ggsave("figures/03_gender.png", p3, width = 5, height = 4, dpi = 300)

# Hepatic fat accumulation (0 = none ... 4 = very severe)
p4 <- ggplot(df, aes(factor(hepatic_fat_accumulation_hfa),
                     fill = gallstone_status)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  labs(title = "Hepatic fat accumulation grade by gallstone status",
       x = "Hepatic fat grade (0 = none, 4 = very severe)",
       y = "Patients", fill = "Status")
p4
ggsave("figures/04_hepatic_fat.png", p4, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

## 4.3 Existing conditions

```{r eda-conditions}
p5 <- df |>
  select(gallstone_status, coronary_artery_disease_cad, hypothyroidism,
         hyperlipidemia, diabetes_mellitus_dm) |>
  pivot_longer(-gallstone_status) |>
  group_by(gallstone_status, name) |>
  summarise(pct_yes = mean(value == "Yes") * 100, .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(name, pct_yes, fill = gallstone_status)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  labs(title = "Prevalence of existing conditions",
       x = NULL, y = "Patients with the condition (%)", fill = "Status")
p5
ggsave("figures/05_conditions.png", p5, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```
## 4.4 Key variables by gallstone status

```{r eda-box, fig.width=11, fig.height=8}
key_vars <- c("age", "body_mass_index_bmi", "total_body_fat_ratio_tbfr_percent",
              "visceral_fat_area_vfa", "visceral_fat_rating_vfr", "glucose",
              "total_cholesterol_tc", "low_density_lipoprotein_ldl",
              "high_density_lipoprotein_hdl", "triglyceride",
              "aspartat_aminotransferaz_ast", "alanin_aminotransferaz_alt",
              "c_reactive_protein_crp", "vitamin_d")

p6 <- df |>
  select(gallstone_status, all_of(key_vars)) |>
  pivot_longer(-gallstone_status) |>
  ggplot(aes(gallstone_status, value, fill = gallstone_status)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ name, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4,
             labeller = label_wrap_gen(24)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  labs(title = "Key clinical variables by gallstone status",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7))
p6
ggsave("figures/06_key_variables.png", p6, width = 11, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```
```{r eda-medians}
df |>
  group_by(gallstone_status) |>
  summarise(across(all_of(key_vars), ~ round(median(.x), 1))) |>
  pivot_longer(-gallstone_status) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = gallstone_status, values_from = value)
```
## 4.5 Correlation between numeric variables

```{r eda-corr, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
num_df <- df |> select(where(is.numeric))
cm <- cor(num_df, method = "spearman")

draw_corr <- function() {
  corrplot(cm, method = "color", type = "lower", order = "hclust",
           tl.cex = 0.6, tl.col = "black", diag = FALSE)
}
draw_corr()                                   # show in notebook

png("figures/07_correlation_heatmap.png", width = 3000, height = 3000, res = 300)
draw_corr()
invisible(dev.off())                          # save to file
```
## 4.6 Principal component analysis

```{r eda-pca}
# TEMPORARY: leave out the single patient with an obesity value near 2000,
# which looks like a data-entry error (we will decide this properly later)
pca_data <- df |> filter(obesity_percent < 150)

pca <- prcomp(select(pca_data, where(is.numeric)), scale. = TRUE)
var_exp <- round(summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100, 1)

scores <- as_tibble(pca$x[, 1:2]) |>
  mutate(status = pca_data$gallstone_status)

p7 <- ggplot(scores, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  stat_ellipse(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols) +
  labs(title = "PCA of numeric variables",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", var_exp[1], "% of variance)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", var_exp[2], "% of variance)"),
       colour = "Status")
p7
ggsave("figures/08_pca.png", p7, width = 6.5, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
